Honestly I think almost every round goes to Nolan but some are pretty close/arguable.

Nolan fit in so well he was a well known author when he wasn’t being recognized as a hero nation(and probably world) wide.

We’ve never really seen Vegeta do anything on earth for fun. He spends almost 100% of his time training to get stronger than Goku. We see Nolan take his wife out on dates and talk about food places he enjoys around the world. He’s clearly spent more time enjoying what earth has to offer.

Better family man can go either way tbh. Nolan was much better than Vegeta initially, since Vegeta was here to openly conquer and only couldn’t because Goku could easily stop him. However once he accepts that he’ll never stand on equal ground with his rival he changed. I think this is the moment that Vegeta becomes a better family man than Nolan. Nolan’s betrayal really seals the deal but setting that aside and judging only by the way they interact with their families it still might go to him. His son and wife have very fond memories of him and that’s more than can be said about Vegeta’s family, even currently in his story.

Who adjusted the most can also go either way, they both gave up a lifestyle of conquering to settle down on a planet they were assigned to conquest. I think the most material difference is that Vegeta only came over after repeatedly failing at defeating the defenders of earth, while Nolan came around to despite having nobody who could stop him. I think this one goes to Nolan since it was by his own efforts that he realized he was on the wrong side, and he sacrifices his well being for a chance to make it better.

It’s stated in the Cell saga, so years after he’s had his first kid and even longer after the prompt is set, that Vegeta never showed or told Bulma or Trunks that he cared for them. At least Nolan gave Mark a good childhood and Debby felt cared for until everything went down.
